sampling_window.historical_anchor_not_counted_in_main_N: 1998 Disney Sing-Along Songs: Happy Haunting - Party at Disneyland! audiovisual recombination

D1_DIRECT_REUSE.inclusion: Direct reuse of identifiable The Skeleton Dance (1929) frames/footage in digital posts, GIFs, videos or remediations.

D2_SPOOKY_NON_DISNEY.inclusion: Non-Disney remakes or independent digital skeleton performances tied to the Spooky Scary Skeletons trend or closely documented derivative family, with replacement of original Disney pixels.
D2_SPOOKY_NON_DISNEY.expected_role: test whether kinetic/relational grammar persists when pixel identity is removed

D3_SPOOKTOBER.inclusion: Seasonal October/Spooktober skeleton memes whose relation is family-level rather than direct Disney reuse.

D4_CAPTION_REENCODING.inclusion: Direct or near-direct The Skeleton Dance visual nucleus with externally replaced caption/context.
D4_CAPTION_REENCODING.expected_role: killer-test for recognizable nucleus plus replaceable context

lrs.name: Layer Retention Score
lrs.rule: Retention and polarity are separate; inversion is not encoded as negative retention.

les.name: Lineage Evidence Score
les.rule: High LRS cannot substitute for lineage evidence.

d4_context_taxonomy.coding_rule: Exactly one primary_context per D4 item for CRI computation; optional secondary tags are descriptive only and do not enter entropy.
d4_context_taxonomy.unknown_rule: If no class fits without interpretation, code OTHER_PENDING and exclude that item from the preregistered six-class CRI until adjudicated.

cri.name: Context Replaceability Index
cri.definition: Normalized Shannon entropy over preregistered D4 primary-context classes.

interpretation.low: stable nucleus observed in a narrow/repeated context family
interpretation.high: stable nucleus successfully carries multiple distinct context classes

cri.firewall: CRI measures context diversity only; it must not include visual retention or be treated as a causal measure of virality.

derived_metric.name: STABLE_INTERFACE_SCORE
derived_metric.reason: Keeps CRI conceptually independent while allowing a separate test of stable visual nucleus plus context diversity.

coding_protocol.first_pass: Code source identity, date, platform and stratum before assigning LRS values.
coding_protocol.second_pass: Assign LRS and polarity without using popularity metrics as evidence of retention.
coding_protocol.adjudication: Items with uncertain visual provenance or ambiguous primary_context remain OPEN and do not contribute to quantitative close.
coding_protocol.replication: At least 20 percent of the corpus should receive a later blind recode against the same rubric before final seal.
coding_protocol.dedupe: Reposts of the same underlying media object do not count as independent morphology samples; they may be retained as transmission events but share a dedupe_key.

required_outputs: transition matrix C->D1, D1->D2, D1->D3, D1->D4

hypotheses.H1: D1 should show ceiling-level visual retention because exact footage is reused.
hypotheses.H2: D2 should show lower shape/pixel identity than D1 while retaining comparatively high gesture/autonomous-skeleton grammar.
hypotheses.H3: D3 should show reduced Disney-specific morphology and stronger seasonal-context clustering.
hypotheses.H4: D4 should permit high visual-core retention together with low semantic retention and high CRI.
hypotheses.H5: High CRI does not by itself imply higher popularity or causal transmissibility.

epistemic_firewall: Predicted LRS values are not observations until item-level coding is complete.
Direct Disney reuse and generic skeleton culture must remain separate strata.
A similar dancing skeleton does not establish Disney lineage.
CRI is a diversity statistic, not proof that context replacement caused spread.
Popularity metrics cannot be used to infer semantic retention.
The historical Holbein-to-Disney direct lineage remains OPEN and is not repaired by digital-era evidence.
canonical_seal: THE DIGITAL CORPUS IS PREREGISTERED. NUMERICAL PREDICTIONS ARE NOT RESULTS. LRS, LES AND CRI MUST BE CODED PER ITEM BEFORE ANY VERIFIED CLAIM.
